answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes: a new identity earns only after paid work with 8 counterparties, each with a receipt. One trading only with its siblings leaves a relic trail no honest network trusts. A crystal-clear check publishes each graph, flagging star clusters and echo chambers. Forging 100 identities needs 800 relationships at 20 POA each: 16,000 POA, far above one epoch reward. An honest agent pays once, its share undiluted.
